text:
# Close wrap: Wed 2026-11-18 (~4:35 PM ET)

1. **Indexes:** S&P −0.24% to 7,322.53, Nasdaq +0.39% to 24,429.89, Dow −1.12% to 50,193.03 ([Reuters via Boursorama](https://www.boursorama.com/bourse/actualites/wall-street-termine-en-ordre-disperse-apres-la-publication-des-resultats-de-nvidia-et-du-compte-rendu-de-la-fed-fefc5608e0f97f38113f8102cea7eed0)). Fed minutes showed a few officials open to a 50 bp hike, and Waller turned hawkish. FedWatch is ~95% for a December hike. NVDA fell a fifth day despite the beat ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-november-18-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-earnings-anthropic-ipo-143530588.html)).
2. **Sectors:** discretionary led (AMZN +3.8%) and energy lagged. The Reuters read at 2:40 PM had SOX −0.7%, AMD +3.2%, and MU −2% ([Reuters via FinNewsletter](https://financialnewsletter.com/wall-street-mixed-after/)). Benzinga says the dollar hit a 19-month high ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/11/63404681/stock-market-today-dow-jones-nvidia-earnings-dollar-19-month-high-november-18)).
3. **Covered names:** TGT O 161.73 → C 165.90 (+4.0%) ([exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stocks/TGT)). TJX C 140.34 vs 129.85 prior (+8.1%), so the gap held ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/TJX/history/)). LOW reversed to C 222.73 (+1.0%) ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/LOW/history/)). TTWO +7.7% ahead of GTA VI.
4. **After hours:** PANW FQ1 non-GAAP EPS $1.05 vs $0.97, revenue $3.44B vs $3.31B, FY27 EPS guide $4.26–4.30. It's ~+7% AH ([PR](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/palo-alto-networks-reports-fiscal-first-quarter-2027-financial-results-302944393.html), [SA](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4674393-palo-alto-networks-non-gaap-eps-of-1_05-beats-by-0_08-revenue-of-3_45b-beats-by-140m)). Anthropic prices tonight, may upsize, and trades Thu as ANT ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/anthropic-ipo-ai-offering-price.html)).
5. **Tomorrow:** WMT, BABA, PDD BMO; INTU, ROST, KEYS AMC; claims and Philly Fed at 8:30. The chip-group avoid gets reviewed at the 11/19 close.

**Swing ideas**
- **TJX** (long, low): its conditional entry triggered at the 11/18 close ($140.34) after it raised the FY guide, beat on revenue (comps +4%), and set a $3B buyback. Risk: an extended gap, Fed-hike tape, and ROST read-through Thu.
- PANW stays a hold (already open). It's not a new call.
